_comment: Copy this to board-accounts.json (gitignored) and put your real board usernames in.
Passwords do NOT go here. Store each one in the macOS Keychain instead:
'username' is the display handle. 'login' is optional — set it when the board
signs you in with an email rather than the handle (the new Kilter does). If a
board's Keychain entry is stored under a different account label than the
handle, add 'keychain' too. Drop a board and pull-boards.py stops syncing it.
